The ADPCS Nurse Executive is responsible for the practice of nursing 24/7. This includes all registered nurses, advanced practice nurses, and allied health staff (LPNs, NAs, etc.) regardless of line authority.

This position functions as an administrator, educator, and consultant with a wide range of experience and authority that is broad enough to improve care for large groups of Veterans through their influence over policy development and decisions at the local, regional, state levels, and beyond.

They are accountable to the Health Care System Medical Director and are an integral part of the senior leadership team.

Duties include but are not limited to: Chief Spokesperson for the organized Nursing Services Strategic planning, organization assessment and program development Participates with Executive Leadership Team and strategic thought leaders in the facility to initiate and execute planning and decision making processes Exercises final authority and approval for job descriptions, policies, and procedures; standards of patient care, treatment, and services; nursing practice standards; staffing plans; functional statements; and standards to measure, assess, and improve patient outcomes Delegates activities to those Service lines under the purview of the ADPCS/Nurse Executive Ensures all Registered Nurses, Advanced Practice Nurses, and licensed Practical/Vocational Nurses are licensed, certified, and/or registered upon employment, and thereafter.

Ensures a competency process is in place to evaluate individual practice, as well as a review process for annual performance ratings Promotes a healthy work environment for nursing through the implementation of shared decision-making Champions a High Reliability Organization (HRO) PLEASE NOTE: This position requires Basic Life Support (BLS) certification.

If selected, applicants will provide proof of current certifications prior to employment. Only BLS certification which includes Automated External Defibrillator (AED) obtained from either the American Heart Association (AHA) or the Military Treatment Training Network (MTN) will be accepted.

VA offers a comprehensive total rewards package: VA Nurse Total Rewards Pay: Competitive salary, regular salary increases, potential for performance awards Paid Time Off: 50 days of paid time off per year (26 days of annual leave, 13 days of sick leave, 11 paid Federal holidays per year) Retirement: Traditional federal pension (5 years vesting) and federal 401K with up to 5% in contributions by VA Insurance: Federal health/vision/dental/term life/long-term care (many federal insurance programs can be carried into retirement) Licensure: 1 full and unrestricted license from any US State or territory Work Schedule: Full Time, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. - 4:30 p.m.

Telework: Telework may be authorized at Supervisor's discretion (Ad-hoc) Virtual: This is not a virtual position. Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: May be Authorized
Basic Requirements: English Language Proficiency. In accordance with 38 U.S.C. 7403(f), no person shall serve in direct patient care positions unless they are proficient in basic written and spoken English.

Graduate of a school of professional nursing approved by the appropriate accrediting agency and accredited by one of the following accrediting bodies at the time the program was completed by the applicant: The Accreditation Commission for Education in Nursing (ACEN) or The Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE); OR Individuals attending a master's level bridge program in nursing who have completed coursework equivalent to a bachelor's level degree in Nursing may have opportunity to become registered as a nurse with a state licensing board prior to completion of the bridge program.

Upon achievement of a State license, the individual may be appointed on temporary basis and later converted to a permanent appointment upon successful completion and graduation from the bridge program.

(Reference VA Handbook 5005, Appendix G6); OR In cases of graduates of foreign schools of professional nursing, possession of a current, full, active, and unrestricted registration will meet the requirement for graduation from an approved school of professional nursing to warrant an appointment as a Nurse who has completed an associated degree/entry level Nursing education program.

Credit for foreign nursing education higher that associate degree/entry level requires a formal degree equivalency validation from a recognized equivalency evaluation accepted by VA such as International Consultants of Delaware (ICD).

Current, full, active, and unrestricted registration as a graduate professional nurse in a State, Territory or Commonwealth (i.e., Puerto Rico) of the United States, or the District of Columbia.

Graduate Nurse Technician (GNT) Exception: Candidates who otherwise meet the basic education requirements, but do not possess the required licensure, may be appointed at the entry step of the grade and level applicable to the completed nursing education as a GNT on a 120-day temporary appointment while actively pursuing licensure (may be extended up to two years on a case-by-case-basis.) NOTE: Grandfathering Provision - All persons currently employed in VHA in 0610 series and performing the duties as described in the qualification standard on the effective date of the standard (1/29/2024) are considered to have met all qualification requirements for the grade held including positive education and licensure/certification.

The following Scope, Education and Dimension criteria must be met to qualify for Nurse V: Scope: Practice of an executive nature, comprised of complex leadership and administrative components, associated with critical health care issues and activities that drive meeting the organizational mission, health care and policy.

Education: Master's degree in Nursing (MSN) and 5 years of professional nursing experience, one of which is specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse IV and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse V; OR Master's degree in a *related field with a BSN and 5 years of professional nursing experience, one of which is specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse IV and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse V; OR a Doctoral degree in Nursing and 4 years of professional nursing experience, one of which is specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse IV and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse V; OR a Doctoral degree in a *related field with a BSN and 4 years of professional nursing experience, one of which is specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse IV and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse V. *Note: Foreign education programs/degrees are not creditable as related degrees.

Dimension Requirements: Leadership. Establishes the strategic direction for health care delivery, evidence-based practices, industry-leading research, and innovative care models. Creates a shared vision and successfully leads change to improve performance and attain measurable outcomes at the organization or enterprise level. Business Acumen.

Transforms health care through the application of new processes, technology, informatics, data analytics, business principles, systems thinking and resource management at the organization or enterprise level. Inspiring an Industry-Leading Lifestyle.

Establishes an industry leading, shared decision-making lifestyle; a workforce that serves Veterans, families, and caregivers of all backgrounds; builds trust and lifestyle competencies and catalyzes dynamic teams at the organization and enterprise level. Communication and Relationship Management.

Drives the effective use of relationship management principles to achieve positive customer service experiences that are consistent with professional and organizational values, beliefs, and practices at the organizational or enterprise level. Professional and Social Responsibility.

Sets the standard for a lifestyle of holistic care, health advocacy and health equity. Applies ethical principles in decision-making at the organization or enterprise level.

Advances nursing knowledge through health science research and the translation and dissemination of evidence into practice to maximize the value to Veterans, the community, and the health care industry.

Preferred Experience: 5+ years in leadership role Served as a Nurse Executive, Deputy and/or Chief Nurse in hospital system, preferably an academic setting Leading quality management, patient safety initiatives Proficient in change management Strong staffing/resource management experience Reference: For more information on this qualification standard, please visit https://www.va.gov/ohrm/QualificationStandards/.

Physical Requirements: This position includes a level of physicality normally associated with duties performed by nurses such as direct patient care, and potentially long periods of walking, standing, sitting, moderate lifting, repeated bending, or kneeling.

Examples may include but are not limited to: Significant amounts of time standing assisting assigned patients Utilization of safe patient handling and mobility protocols

RN Pay Scale NY48 Note to VA Employees: Grades and steps will be unaffected by this change but could result in a change to your current salary due to different pay scales. To improve the care primary care teams can offer their most complex Veterans at highest risk for adverse outcomes.

Providing the best care for our most vulnerable Veterans is an important part of the mission of all health care teams serving the VHA.The specific patient population to whom direct care is provided includes adults with a variety of different conditions.

The incumbent must also be able to direct non professional staff's lifting, moving, and/or transferring of patients, and use equipment to provide patient care which usually involves lifting and/or pushing the equipment. The RN is responsible for the storage, proper cleaning techniques, and use of reusable medical equipment (RME).

He/She is responsible for carrying out proper procedures for caring for patients in an isolation environment by following proper infection control procedures.

Communicates regularly with nurse managers, physicians, nursing supervisors, charge nurses, transfer coordinators, allied healthcare staff, healthcare technicians, Pharmacy, and the business office.The RN's role will include, but is not limited to the following duties: Establishing nursing diagnoses.

Providing health education and procedural teaching to patients and significant others. Administering and evaluating pharmacological and other therapeutic treatment regimens. Administering medicine Administering Injections - Vaccines etc. Establishing priorities and making ethically-sound decisions to ensure safe patient care.

Assisting the physicians during diagnostic and therapeutic procedures to promote optimal patient outcomes by team collaboration. Responding to emergency situations to promote optimal patient outcomes by recognizing changes in patients' health status. Performing diagnostic studies within the scope of nursing practice as ordered by the physician.

Documenting patient data to ensure continuity in the provision and coordination of patient care. Utilize risk stratification and population health reports to identify these populations and theirprominent needs.

Responsible for providing competent, evidence-based care to assigned patients and oversight of licensed vocational nurses/nursing assistants, as appropriate to the setting. Collaborating with other health care professionals.

Collaborates with the care team, implements care plans, delivers evidence-based interventions, communicates with the veteran and their family, and facilitates the phasing of care and services to support health goals. Communicating with veterans ad family members regarding veteran's care.

May be responsible for charge nurse duties Managing follow-up care. Complete comprehensive assessments, provide referrals to service resources, manage the delivery of labor-intensive services, and ensure appropriate documentation and scheduling. Acting as resource to others.

Participating in continuing educational activities, achieving/maintaining certification. The individual will assist in directing the provision of nursing education, orientation, competencies and providing quality improvement and outcomes utilization consultation.

Possess knowledge of unit level performance measures and participates in quality improvement monitoring Additional duties as assigned Preferred Experience: Acute Care experience and/or previous Ambulatory Care experience VA offers a comprehensive total rewards package: VA Nurse Total Rewards Pay: Competitive salary, regular salary increases, potential for performance awards Paid Time Off: 50 days of paid time off per year (26 days of annual leave, 13 days of sick leave, 11 paid Federal holidays per year) Retirement: Traditional federal pension (5 years vesting) and federal 401K with up to 5% in contributions by VA Insurance: Federal health/vision/dental/term life/long-term care (many federal insurance programs can be carried into retirement) Licensure: 1 full and unrestricted license from any US State or territory Work Schedule: Day Shift, Monday-Friday Telework: Ad Hoc may be authorized Virtual: This is not a virtual position.

Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: Not Authorized Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not Authorized Financial Disclosure Report: Not required

Grade/Level Scope Education Nurse I, Level I Delivers fundamental, knowledge-based care to assigned clients while developing technical competencies. An Associate Degree (ADN) or Diploma in Nursing, with no additional professional nursing required.

Nurse I, Level II Demonstrates integration of biopsychosocial concepts, cognitive skills and technically competent practice in providing care to clients with basic or complex.

An ADN or Diploma in Nursing AND 1 year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse I, Level 1 ;OR a Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) with no additional professional nursing experience required. Nurse I, Level III Demonstrates proficiency in practice based on conscious and deliberate planning.

Self-directed in goal setting for managing complex client situations.

An ADN or Diploma in Nursing AND 2 years of professional nursing experience in which one year is equivalent to Nurse I, Level 2; OR a BSN and 1 year of professional nursing experience equivalent to the Nurse I, Level 2; OR a Master's degree in nursing (MSN) and no additional professional nursing experience; OR a Master's degree in a *related field with a BSN and no additional professional nursing experience.

A BSN with 2 years of professional nursing equivalent to Nurse I, Level 3; OR an MSN with one year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse I, Level 3; OR a Master's degree in a *related field with a BSN and one year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse I, Level 3; OR a Doctoral degree in Nursing with no professional nursing experience; OR a Doctoral degree in a *related field with a BSN with no additional professional nursing experience.

MSN and 2 years of specialized nursing experience, one of which is equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III; OR a Master's degree in *related field with BSN and two years of specialized nursing experience, one of which is equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III; OR a Doctoral degree in Nursing with and one year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III; OR a Doctoral degree in a *related field with a BSN and one year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III. *Note: Foreign education programs/degrees are not creditable as related degrees.

Physical Requirements: You must be able to perform work that requires regular and recurrent bending, lifting 30 pounds or more, stooping, climbing, twisting and/or bending, standing and/or walking almost constantly during the course of the day, reaching above the shoulder, stretching, and similar activities supporting various weights; walking and standing for 8 hours; frequent pushing medication carts, wheelchairs, litters, beds; use of fingers, both hands and both legs; emotional stability (you must be able to care for Veterans with various medical and psychiatric illnesses who at times may exhibit unpredictable behavior and may have the potential to be physically or verbally assaultive); near vision correctable at 13" to 16" / far vision correctable in one eye to 20/50 and to 20/100 in the other / both eyes required with ability to distinguish basic colors; hearing aid permitted in order to sufficiently hear various alarms and respond immediately

The Inpatient Spinal Cord Injury/Disorder Registered Nurse will function as an integral member of the Spinal Cord Division. These are exciting opportunities to work in a diverse environment.

Position offers opportunities to provide bedside care for acute and chronic disease management, palliative care patients, rehabilitation and complex medical patients.

Responsibilities of the incumbent in this position include but are not limited to: Managing the day to day needs of an acutely ill patient population with spinal cord injuries/disorders (SCI/D) Medication administration and documentation requirements Health promotion, Veteran/Caregiver education and supporting patient self-determination Collaborative practice with interdisciplinary SCI/D team Application of principles of rehabilitation nursing care to promote the highest level of functional independence Adhering to established safety practices, delegating and guiding assistive personnel, and supporting process/quality improvement initiatives on the unit and across the organization Preferred Experience: BSN Preferred CRRN - Rehabilitation certification preferred Acute care nursing experience preferred Interest or experience in SCI/Rehabilitation Nursing preferred Ability to multitask and manage complex patient needs High level of flexibility/adaptability needed to meet fast paced environment Strong interpersonal, oral and written communication skills Committed to supporting a healthy work environment VA offers a comprehensive total rewards package: VA Nurse Total Rewards Pay: Competitive salary, regular salary increases, potential for performance awards Paid Time Off: Up to 50 days of paid time off per year (26 days of annual leave, 13 days of sick leave, 11 paid Federal holidays per year) Retirement: Traditional federal pension (5 years vesting) and federal 401K with up to 5% in contributions by VA Insurance: Federal health/vision/dental/term life/long-term care (many federal insurance programs can be carried into retirement) Licensure: 1 full and unrestricted license from any US State or territory Work Schedule: PMs - 1530-2400, Alternating weekends and holidays Telework: Not available Virtual: This is not a virtual position.

Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them.

Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales.

Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025). *]:pointer-events-auto scroll-mt-[calc(var(--header-height)+min(200px,max(70px,20svh)))]" data-turn-id="request-6973a1b9-fbd8-8325-be36-66622ef94b91-13" data-testid="conversation-turn-40" data-scroll-anchor="true" data-turn="assistant"> Cadence Health is seeking a Care Management Registered Nurse to support patients enrolled in our Advanced Primary Care Management (APCM) program.

In this role, you will proactively monitor patient data, evaluate clinical information, and deliver timely interventions to promote patient safety and improved health outcomes.

You will work closely with interdisciplinary care teams to reinforce care plans, support medication adherence, close care gaps, and provide patient education that empowers individuals to actively manage their health and chronic conditions.

Licensure Requirements ActiveCompact Multi-State RN license is required Schedule Requirements: This role requires availability Monday - Friday.

Schedule hours are 8 :00 AM to 5:00 PM in Pacific Time What you'll do: Proactively monitor patient vitals, symptoms, and relevant clinical data to identify care gaps and patients who require timely intervention. Develop, implement, and manage individualized care plans aligned with physician recommendations and patient-specific health goals.

Engage with patients via phone and secure messaging to address concerns, manage escalations, and provide empathetic, responsive clinical support. Conduct virtual follow-up visits to support program onboarding, adjust care plans, reinforce medication adherence, and help patients progress toward lifestyle and health goals.

Document all clinical interactions accurately and efficiently, and prepare clear care summaries for patients’ primary care providers to ensure seamless coordination. Partner with interdisciplinary care teams to deliver high-quality, patient-centered care across chronic conditions such as CHF, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes.

Contribute to the development and refinement of clinical workflows and processes to support efficient, scalable, and high-impact care management programs. Represent Cadence ’s commitment to exceptional care in every patient interaction, aligning with the standards and goals of our health system partners.

What you'll need: Multi-state RN Compact State Licensure. Associate Degree in Nursing Science. 5+ years of recent clinical experience as an RN in anICU/ER setting is preferred. Prior experience supporting patients in a chronic care management program is a plus.

To ensure that our clinicians have the necessary tools for a successful remote work environment, home office setups must have consistently stable wifi with strong upload and download speeds. A wifi speed test is required before participating in the interview process to verify that these standards are met. Skilled in nursing processes.

Excellent clinical acumen. Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. EMR experience, preferably in Athena and EPIC. Works effectively with minimum supervision. Strong collaboration with cross-functional partners.

Ability to support the delivery of health care to patients by performing a variety of activities and procedures that are prescribed by and performed under the direction of the Cadence Nurse Practitioner and Cadence clinical policies and procedures. Patient assessment competency.

Technical fluency with the ability to work in multiple platforms and systems, including Notion, Athena, EPIC, Zendesk, and G Suite. The anticipated base salary range for this role is $80,000 to $90,000 annual base salary , which is based on role scope, level, and location.

In addition to base compensation, this role may be eligible for incentive compensation as part of the overall total rewards package. This position is remote and based in the United States. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, internal equity, and applicable law.

Benefits & Perks Competitive pay & equity* Fully remote Comprehensive health coverage: Medical, dental & vision Paid time off 401k plan + matching Paid parental leave Home office stipend *benefit offerings may vary depending on job profile, job level and worker type Cadence is committed to equal opportunity and fairness regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, nation of origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, country of citizenship, medical condition, marital or domestic partner status, family status, family care status, military or veteran status or any other basis protected by local, state or federal laws.

The Care Manager Registered Nurse responsibility is to demonstrates integration of biopsychosocial concepts, cognitive skills, and technically competent practice while providing care to clients. Assesses, plans, implements, and evaluates the effectiveness of the Veteran's care.

Serves to support delivery of high quality, timely care to the Veteran receiving services in the community.

Assumes responsibility for the coordination of care focused on patient education, self-management, and customer satisfaction throughout the continuum of care to include other duties but are not limited to: The Care Manager possesses intimate knowledge of the internal referral care process, clinical review criteria, utilization management standards, clinical documentation requirements, community care regulations, and Veterans Health Administration (VHA) standards and guidelines.

The Care Manager uses nursing knowledge and systems theory to assess, organize, facilitate, and guide Veterans through their full range of care options including internal/direct care in Veterans Affairs (VA) and care in the community.

The Care Manager serves as a liaison to both internal and community providers and is responsible for managing the care of the Veteran throughout the consult process.

The Care Manager supports the medical center's mission to improve timely access to care, ensure Veterans who want to receive care in the community are referred and scheduled into the community, and support the delivery of high quality, timely care to the Veteran receiving community services.

The Care Manager will work collaboratively within the Office of Integrated Veteran Care (IVC) to triage Request for Services (RFS) to coordinate care processes defined by the IVC Field Guidebook to include developing a care coordination plan, reviewing medical documentation from community providers, communication of care coordination needs, and supporting the Veteran through the completion of the episode of care.

The Care Manager will influence care outcomes by collaborating with members of the interdisciplinary team both within the VA and in the community. The Care Manager will comply with VA-mandated processes and use of health information solutions that serve to assess, document, exchange, and track care coordination information.

The Care Manager will utilize delegation of authority, if applicable, to function at their highest level of role performance and align high-quality care with key performance indicators to ensure practice standards meet patient care needs.

Duties require the ability to apply specialized principles and practices to ensure a systems approach to healthcare delivery. The QM Consultant directly supports facility leadership in areas of planning, organization, development, direction, and evaluation of the quality program within the facility.

Oversees the coordination, implementation, and continuous improvement of clinical referral management processes to ensure timely, appropriate, and Veteran-centered care.

Serves as the liaison between Surgery Service, specialty providers, nursing staff, administrative personnel, and leadership to facilitate efficient referral coordination and communication.

Supervises nursing and clinical staff by planning work assignments, establishing priorities, monitoring workload distribution, and ensuring efficient daily operations.

Ensures nursing care and referral management activities comply with Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Office of Community Care (OCC), accreditation, regulatory, and professional practice standards.

Leads quality improvement initiatives by analyzing referral management data, monitoring program performance metrics, identifying trends, and recommending operational improvements.

Develops, revises, and implements standard operating procedures, policies, and workflows in response to changes in national directives, OCC guidance, VISN requirements, and facility policies. Collaborates with physicians, specialty consultants, and interdisciplinary teams to improve clinical coordination, referral processes, and patient outcomes.

Reviews clinical documentation to ensure compliance with Referral Coordination Initiative requirements, regulatory standards, and organizational policies. Monitors program performance through data analysis, prepares reports and presentations, and provides recommendations to executive leadership for process improvement.

Recruits, interviews, selects, mentors, and develops staff while collaborating with Human Resources to support timely hiring and workforce planning. Evaluates employee performance by establishing expectations, conducting competency assessments, completing performance evaluations, and providing ongoing coaching and feedback.

Identifies staff educational needs and coordinates orientation, continuing education, competency validation, and mandatory training to support professional development and regulatory compliance.

Addresses employee relations matters by resolving workplace concerns, counseling staff, recommending disciplinary actions when appropriate, and ensuring adherence to labor relations and Equal Employment Opportunity requirements.

Ensures exceptional customer service by promoting Veteran-centered care, improving patient satisfaction, and supporting safe, respectful, and equitable healthcare delivery.

Maintains operational readiness by monitoring compliance with accreditation standards, patient safety initiatives, infection prevention practices, and organizational performance requirements.

Performs referral management and clinical review activities to maintain subject matter expertise, identify operational barriers, and support efficient patient access to specialty care.

Participates in facility, VISN, and interdisciplinary committees, task forces, and workgroups to advance nursing practice, referral coordination, and organizational initiatives. Analyzes current and future workforce requirements to determine staffing needs, competency requirements, and resource allocation to meet program objectives.

Provides leadership coverage for senior Referral Coordination Program management as assigned and performs other related duties necessary to support organizational and patient care objectives.

## Company Description ##
Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Le Département de médecine de premier recours (DMPR) a pour mission sociétale de permettre un accès aux soins de qualité pour tous par une médecine de proximité, d-assurer la prise en charge des urgences médicales et chirurgicales légères, de promouvoir la prévention auprès des citoyennes et citoyens, d-apporter les connaissances médicales aux investigations judiciaires et de promouvoir la santé des voyageurs et voyageuses.
Le service de médecine tropicale et humanitaire assure la prise en charge de patients ayant voyagé et présentant une pathologie d-importation, tropicale ou parasitaire et prodigue des conseils de prévention. Il effectue des vaccinations spécialisées pour les voyageurs, les expatriés, les étudiants et la population locale. Par ailleurs, ce service participe activement aux interventions vaccinales en cas d-épidémie ou autre besoin identifié.
## Job Description ##
En qualité d-infirmier ou infirmière au Service de médecine tropicale et humanitaire (SMTH), votre mission consiste à mener de manière autonome des consultations infirmières de pré-voyage auprès d-une patientèle très diversifiée (expatriés, familles, humanitaires, immunosupprimés).
Vous menez et gérez des consultations infirmières de première ligne de manière autonome, dans le respect des missions, des protocoles et des délégations qui vous sont confiés.
Vous assurez également une activité de conseil aux voyageurs et voyageuses en formulant des recommandations personnalisées en matière de prévention des risques liés au voyage (vaccinations, prophylaxie, mesures d-hygiène, prévention des maladies infectieuses et autres risques sanitaires). Vous participez activement aux campagnes de vaccinations sur différents sites.
Vous travaillez en collaboration avec une équipe pluriprofessionnelle ainsi qu-avec les réseaux de soins internes et externes, notamment les organisations non gouvernementales, les organisations internationales et les partenaires présents au Global Health Campus.
Votre empathie, votre sens du relationnel et votre capacité à créer un climat de confiance vous permettent de vous positionner comme un partenaire de soins à part entière.
Doté ou dotée d-une excellente capacité d-adaptation et de l-organisation, vous êtes en mesure de faire face à des flux de patients importants et variables tout en maintenant une prise en charge de qualité. Vous gérez sereinement les imprévus et les situations génératrices de stress.
Vous possédez d-excellentes compétences relationnelles, un sens développé d l-accueil et une communication bienveillante, vous permettant de répondre aux attentes d-une patientèle exigeante et multiculturelle.
Dans le cadre de votre activité, vous êtes amené ou amenée à intervenir sur deux sites.

Vous possédez un Bachelor HES en soins infirmiers ou un diplôme en soins infirmiers équivalent reconnu par la Croix-Rouge suisse.
Vous avez une pratique professionnelle diversifiée de plus de 4 ans dans le domaine de la santé publique et/ou en santé communautaire et des connaissances en vaccinologie. Vous êtes au bénéfice d-une formation à l-évaluation clinique infirmière.
Une formation en médecine tropicale et des voyageurs constitue un réel atout.
Vous disposez d-un très bon niveau d-anglais, tant à l-oral qu-à l-écrit. La maitrise d-une autre langue, constitue un atout.
Vous savez vous adapter à divers contextes, aux imprévus, aux variations de charge de travail.
Vous possédez d-excellentes compétences relationnelles, un sens de l-accueil d-une communication bienveillante.

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?
Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.
Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

The Outpatient Behavioral Health (BH) Registered Nurse (RN) executes position responsibilities to improve Veteran and organizational outcomes.

The psychiatric BH RN executes their position duties by providing patient-centered, recovery-oriented principles, telemental health, community-based care, and self-awareness when caring for Veterans living with BH conditions.

The BH RN actively engages in interdisciplinary team huddles and meetings, uses therapeutic communication techniques, de-escalation practices, recovery-oriented language, and educates Veterans, their families, and significant others on illnesses, medications, and treatment plans.

The BH RN assists and/or directs safety concern resolution and collaborates with program leadership to help improve Veteran and program outcomes, liaising with Inpatient BH Units, develops content as well as facilitates nurse-led psychoeducational groups, and directs teams response to psychiatric and medical emergencies.

The BH RN documents assessments, risk screens, measurement-based care tools, clinical reminders, and Veteran care plans following facility policy, maintaining professional boundaries and acting in the Veteran's best interest.

The registered nurse (RN) assigned to the outpatient Behavioral Health team collaborates with interdisciplinary treatment teams in the delivery and coordination of comprehensive care to Veterans receiving outpatient behavioral health services.

The RN may work in, be assigned to, or provide cross-coverage for any Behavioral Health Service (BHS) program, Community Based Outpatient Clinics (CBOCs), or facility under the El Paso VA Health Care System based on patient care needs and operational requirements.

Assignments may include, but are not limited to, the Behavioral Health Access Team (BHAT), Primary Care Mental Health Integration (PCMHI), Behavioral Health Interdisciplinary Program (BHIP), Somatic Treatments (i.e Esketamine, etc.), Hospital Liaison, Intensive Community Mental Health Recovery (ICMHR), Housing and Urban Development-VA Supportive Housing (HUD-VASH).

The RN must maintain a current, valid, and unrestricted driver's license and possess the ability to safely operate a Government Services Administration (GSA) vehicle.

Driving responsibilities may include travel between CBOCs & Main VA Facility within the El Paso VA Health Care System, community-based and home visits, outreach activities, and minimal transportation of Veterans when necessary and consistent with VA policy and operational requirements.

This requirement supports the RN's responsibility to provide coverage and services across BHS programs, community settings, CBOCs, and other facilities that fall under the El Paso VA Health Care System.

Behavioral Health Services (BHS) provides a comprehensive range of services, including walk-in/same-day access, crisis assessment and management, group programming, evidence-based treatments, tele-mental health services, medication management, case management/Mental Health Treatment Coordinator (MHTC) services, counseling for couples and families, psychological assessment, outreach, and other behavioral health services.

The responsibilities of the Behavioral Health Registered Nurse (BH RN) include, but are not limited to, conducting risk assessments, triage, and clinical nursing services for Veterans seeking or receiving behavioral health care.

The BH RN addresses Secure Messaging (SM), Message Managers (MM), and other Veteran care requests within established facility policy and standards for timeliness, responding directly within the RN's scope of practice and appropriately routing, reassigning, or escalating requests to the appropriate team, provider, or service when indicated.

The RN reviews diagnostic and laboratory results, discusses abnormal findings with the referring or responsible provider, and communicates normal results to Veterans and/or caregivers, as appropriate. Other duties as assigned.

Participer à la prévention des infections et à la sécurité des patients.
Superviser la qualité des transmissions et des prestations de soins.

Participer au développement et à l’harmonisation des pratiques professionnelles.

# **Infirmier en santé mental** #
## Description de l'entreprise ##
Pour notre partenaire, une clinique de jour spécialisée dans la prise en soins de patients présentant une crise psychique ne nécessitant pas de traitement hospitalier, nous recherchons **un-e infirmier-ère** pour un poste fixe.
La mission de la clinique de jour est d'offrir une prise en charge intensive sur une période de 5 à 6 semaines, à plein temps, du lundi au vendredi. L'objectif est de favoriser la stabilisation psychique des patients et de les accompagner vers un suivi durable et adapté à leurs besoins.
Les patients bénéficient de l'accompagnement d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire composée notamment de médecins, psychologues, infirmiers, assistants sociaux, art-thérapeutes et aides-soignants.
Poste à 100% du lundi au vendredi de 08H à 17h30
## Description du poste ##
* Accueillir et prendre en charge les urgences psychiatriques.
* Assurer des soins subaigus de courte durée.
* Participer aux consultations psychiatriques, psychothérapeutiques et psychologiques ambulatoires.
* Réaliser des prestations de soins : entretiens, bilans sanguins, ECG et accompagnement à la médication.
* Participer aux interventions dans le milieu de vie des patients lorsque nécessaire.
* Contribuer à l'animation et au suivi des groupes psychothérapeutiques.
* Collaborer aux prises en charge complémentaires telles que l'art-thérapie et l'ergothérapie.
* Participer au bilan et au suivi social en collaboration avec les professionnels concernés.
* Assurer des entretiens de suivi dans le cadre d'obligations de soins émises par les autorités.
* Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe pluridisciplinaire afin d'assurer une prise en charge cohérente et de qualité.
## Profil recherché ##
* Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'infirmier-ère reconnu.
* Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine de la psychiatrie ou de la santé mentale.
* Une expérience dans la prise en charge de patients en situation de crise ou d'urgence psychiatrique constitue un atout.
* Vous êtes à l'aise avec le travail en équipe pluridisciplinaire et faites preuve d'autonomie, d'écoute et d'empathie.
* Vous disposez de bonnes capacités d'adaptation et savez gérer des situations complexes avec calme et professionnalisme.
* Vous êtes motivé-e à accompagner les patients dans leur processus de stabilisation et de rétablissement.

Serve as a liaison between referring providers and specialty care services. Outpatient specialty clinic care coordination and patient flow management, including appointment management. Facilitate the timely and clinically appropriate processing of referrals throughout the facility and region.

Clinically review internal consults/referrals for medical necessity of requested services using clinical judgment, triage tools, and care coordination agreements. Graduate of a school of professional nursing approved by the appropriate accrediting agency and accredited by one of the following accrediting bodies at the time the program was completed by the applicant: The Accreditation Commission for Education in Nursing (ACEN) or The Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE); OR Individuals attending a master's level bridge program in nursing who have completed coursework equivalent to a bachelor's level degree in Nursing may have opportunity to become registered as a nurse with a state licensing board prior to completion of the bridge program.

Credit for foreign nursing education higher that associate degree/entry level requires a formal degree equivalency validation from a recognized equivalency evaluation accepted by VA such as International Consultants of Delaware (ICD).

Self-directed in goal setting for managing complex client situations.
